info.name: VNYX Review Verification (backend + Hermes)
info.description:
End-to-end tests for the review-queue verification endpoint.

TWO SERVICES, run side by side:
  vnyx-api  http://localhost:8000   (PORT in its .env)
  hermes    http://localhost:8080

Run folder 0 first — it logs in and stores the token and tenantId as collection variables, so nothing else needs manual setup.

Folder 3 talks to Hermes DIRECTLY with hand-built payloads. Those need no database and no login, so they are the fastest way to see the rule engine work and the only part that runs if your DB is unreachable.

variable.description: Frontend origin for the editUrl in folder-3 fixtures, which Hermes echoes back. Set to the DEPLOYED app because there is no local frontend and the backend reads the same dev database — so the link opens the real record. Keep it in step with PUBLIC_APP_BASE_URL in the backend .env.
Filled in by '0.2 Login'. Do not edit by hand.
Seeded by login; override to sweep another tenant.

item.name: 2.3 Grade ladder — what the factor really is

request.description:
The tenant's grade ladder, straight from the API — the same rows the verification feed joins per product.

Run this after changing a Regrade Factor in Product settings > Pricing Multiplier to confirm the new value is what the checker sees. It is read per request, so a change takes effect on the next call: no redeploy, no cache, no policy.yaml edit.

UNITS WARNING: this endpoint is asymmetric. `priceMultiplier` comes back as a whole percent (200) because the route scales it, but `priceFactor` comes back as the raw fraction (0.5) because it does not. Both are WRITTEN as whole percents. The verification feed reads priceFactor straight from the database, so it always sees the fraction and is unaffected — but do not GET-then-PUT this payload unchanged, or 0.5 will be stored as 0.005.

- The women's W28 maps to EU 36 on this tenant's chart. The generic waist table says 40 -> SIZE.002, off by 4.

Expect zero findings. Remove the `catalog` key from the body and re-send: both fire, each carrying `detail.basis = "policy"` so you can see which side judged them. (TAX.006 stays silent without a catalog rather than guessing a guide name.)
